cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've put my wet sock beside your dinner. From your puddle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then you won't mind it sharing the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An apology would dry the atmosphere considerably.

mechanism: A displays a pupil mess as a lesson in consideration, making a spoken apology the quickest way to remove the uncomfortable demonstration.
confusable: Not merely correcting cleaning technique: the object stays visible to make acknowledgment easier than minimizing the inconvenience.
comparison: Physical damp sock at dinner versus a documented timeline of delay.
seedUse: Keep D27 puddle/sock/table pressure; S05 past cleanup lesson motivates the personal disappointment and prompted apology.
